notes: Combined the RC circuit (first image) and the buzzer circuit (second image) on one breadboard, using the second image's orientation (rows f-j = bank 'b'; the first image shows the same circuit on the other half).

Pi header pins read from the images: red wire = pin 1 (3V3), green = GPIO4 (pin 7), black = GND (pin 6); buzzer green = GPIO17 (pin 11), black = GND (pin 9). Which GND.n port is used is arbitrary since all GND ports are symmetric.
The 1µF capacitor is modelled with capacitor-10uf (the only polarized electrolytic in the catalogue) with value=1uF. Capacitor POS shares the strip with LDR leg 2 and GPIO4; NEG goes to GND.

Buzzer pin 1 is the positive (red) leg to GPIO17; pin 2 is the negative (black) leg to GND. The manual's mention of socket-pin jumper leads for the final build and the laser pointer/straw is not modelled; the straw and laser pointer are not electrical parts.
Exact breadboard rows/columns are estimated from the Fritzing images (LDR at cols 1 and 3, capacitor at cols 3 and 5, buzzer at cols 28 and 30).
